_about: Config for audit_inheritance.py (resources/Layer Definition of Done.md, section 8). Stacks below each layer come from the backward chains (steam_layout/chains.py: who adds the layer, back to Base, plus bystanders); 'targets' can add extra stacks (bottom to top, with a why) and records decisions for routes that stay open: allow (intended, with why) or todo (awaiting the author). Default-layout names; 'variants' maps them for alternative. Every Always On layer is audited automatically. A source-mode change above a definer blocks inheritance (author, 2026-10-01), so RTP Double Tap's dpad-mode right pad already blocks Base's mouse-mode touch; its former allow decision was retired.
